lines.para: An American series broadcast on FX from 30 January 2013 to 30 May 2018, over six seasons. Its creator, Joe Weisberg, spent a few years at the CIA before becoming a novelist.

The story: in the early 1980s, under Reagan, two KGB officers live as an ordinary American couple in a Washington suburb. They run a travel agency, raise two children who know nothing, and live next door to an FBI agent tasked with hunting Soviet illegals.
The final season starts in the United States on 28 March 2018. The day after this recording.
